## Changes in 1.0.1

- **Fog of war**: campaign missions start under the fog again, with the map unexplored, as in the original. Before, some started with the whole map in view, such as the first mission of The Burden of the Crown. The maps that come with the game also get fog and an unexplored map by default on the setup screen.
- **Large units take 2×2 cells, as in the original**: the dragon, catapults, ballistas, traders and carts, galleons, hulks and xebecs. They no longer slip through gaps meant for a single cell. They aim from their centre and face what they strike, so the dragon now attacks right next to a building.
- **Landings**: a ship unloads when any cell around its whole hull is shore. Before, large ships could fail to land their troops.
- **Fish patches** take 2×2 cells too: they no longer drift onto each other or under a ship.
